problem:
Problem description
- There is a single meal-planning horizon $$\mathcal{T}=\{1\}$$.
- The available food items are partitioned into protein items indexed by $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$ and vegetable items indexed by $$v \in \mathcal{V}$$.
- Each protein item $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$ has a protein yield $$\pi_p$$ per unit, a unit cost $$c_p$$, and a unit weight $$w_p$$. Protein items may be purchased in any nonnegative quantity measured in units of $$100\text{g}$$.
- Each vegetable item $$v \in \mathcal{V}$$ has a protein yield $$\pi_v$$ per pack, a pack cost $$c_v$$, and a pack weight $$w_v$$. Vegetable purchases are made in packs.
- The planning goal is to choose a combination of protein and vegetable purchases that maximizes total protein intake for the meal.
- The total spending must stay within the budget $$B$$.
- The total purchased food weight must not exceed the weight limit $$W^{\max}$$.
- At least $$K$$ distinct vegetable types must be selected.
- A vegetable type may only be purchased if it is selected.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_p$$: purchased quantity of protein item $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$, measured in units of $$100\text{g}$$.
  - $$z_v$$: purchased number of packs of vegetable item $$v \in \mathcal{V}$$.
  - $$y_v$$: binary selection indicator for vegetable item $$v \in \mathcal{V}$$, where $$1$$ means selected and $$0$$ means not selected.
  - $$Z$$: total protein achieved by the chosen meal plan.

Input Format
{
  "time_horizon": {
    "periods": "$$\\mathcal{T}=\\{1\\}$$"
  },
  "protein_items": {
    "count": "$$|\\mathcal{P}|$$",
    "names": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{P}|$$",
    "protein_per_unit_g": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{P}|$$, where entry $$\\pi_p$$ is the protein yield per unit for protein item $$p \\in \\mathcal{P}$$",
    "cost_per_unit": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{P}|$$, where entry $$c_p$$ is the unit cost for protein item $$p \\in \\mathcal{P}$$",
    "weight_per_unit_g": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{P}|$$, where entry $$w_p$$ is the unit weight for protein item $$p \\in \\mathcal{P}$$"
  },
  "vegetable_items": {
    "count": "$$|\\mathcal{V}|$$",
    "names": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{V}|$$",
    "protein_per_pack_g": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{V}|$$, where entry $$\\pi_v$$ is the protein yield per pack for vegetable item $$v \\in \\mathcal{V}$$",
    "cost_per_pack": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{V}|$$, where entry $$c_v$$ is the pack cost for vegetable item $$v \\in \\mathcal{V}$$",
    "weight_per_pack_g": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{V}|$$, where entry $$w_v$$ is the pack weight for vegetable item $$v \\in \\mathcal{V}$$"
  },
  "budget": "$$B$$, the maximum total spending allowed",
  "max_total_weight_g": "$$W^{\\max}$$, the maximum total food weight allowed in grams",
  "min_distinct_vegetables": "$$K$$, the minimum number of different vegetable types that must be selected",
  "variable_domains": {
    "protein_purchase": "$$x_p \\ge 0$$ for all $$p \\in \\mathcal{P}$$",
    "vegetable_purchase": "$$z_v \\in \\mathbb{Z}_{\\ge 0}$$ for all $$v \\in \\mathcal{V}$$",
    "vegetable_selected": "$$y_v \\in \\{0,1\\}$$ for all $$v \\in \\mathcal{V}$$"
  }
}

Output Format
{
  "protein_purchase": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{P}|$$, where entry $$x_p$$ is the chosen purchase quantity of protein item $$p \\in \\mathcal{P}$$ in units of $$100\\text{g}$$",
  "vegetable_purchase": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{V}|$$, where entry $$z_v$$ is the chosen number of packs of vegetable item $$v \\in \\mathcal{V}$$",
  "vegetable_selected": "array of length $$|\\mathcal{V}|$$, where entry $$y_v$$ indicates whether vegetable item $$v \\in \\mathcal{V}$$ is selected",
  "total_protein": "$$Z$$, the total protein obtained by the selected meal plan"
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "time_horizon": {
    "periods": 1
  },
  "protein_items": {
    "count": 3,
    "names": ["chicken", "salmon", "tofu"],
    "protein_per_unit_g": [23, 20, 8],
    "cost_per_unit": [3.0, 5.0, 1.5],
    "weight_per_unit_g": [100, 100, 100]
  },
  "vegetable_items": {
    "count": 5,
    "names": ["broccoli", "carrots", "spinach", "bell_pepper", "mushrooms"],
    "protein_per_pack_g": [2.8, 0.9, 2.9, 1.0, 3.1],
    "cost_per_pack": [1.2, 0.8, 1.5, 1.0, 2.0],
    "weight_per_pack_g": [100, 100, 100, 100, 100]
  },
  "budget": 20,
  "max_total_weight_g": 800,
  "min_distinct_vegetables": 3
}

parameters.name: time_horizon_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the meal-planning horizon

parameters.name: protein_yield_per_unit
parameters.description: Protein yield per unit for each protein item

parameters.name: protein_cost_per_unit
parameters.description: Cost per unit for each protein item

parameters.name: protein_weight_per_unit
parameters.description: Weight per unit for each protein item

parameters.name: vegetable_protein_yield_per_pack
parameters.description: Protein yield per pack for each vegetable item

parameters.name: vegetable_cost_per_pack
parameters.description: Cost per pack for each vegetable item

parameters.name: vegetable_weight_per_pack
parameters.description: Weight per pack for each vegetable item

parameters.name: budget
parameters.description: Total spending limit for the meal plan

parameters.name: min_distinct_vegetables
parameters.description: Minimum number of distinct vegetable types to select

variables.name: protein_purchase_quantity
variables.description: Purchased quantity of each protein item in units of 100g

variables.name: vegetable_purchase_packs
variables.description: Purchased number of packs of each vegetable item

variables.name: vegetable_selected
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if the vegetable item is selected, 0 otherwise

variables.name: total_protein
variables.description: Total protein achieved by the meal plan

auxiliary_variables.name: vegetable_big_m
auxiliary_variables.description: Item-specific upper bound for vegetable purchases used to linearize purchase-implies-selection

constraints.name: nonnegative_protein_purchase
constraints.description: Protein purchase quantities must be nonnegative

constraints.name: nonnegative_vegetable_purchase
constraints.description: Vegetable purchase quantities must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: binary_vegetable_selection
constraints.description: Vegetable selection indicators must be binary

constraints.name: budget_limit
constraints.description: Total spending must not exceed the available budget

constraints.name: weight_limit
constraints.description: Total purchased food weight must not exceed the maximum total weight

constraints.name: minimum_vegetable_diversity
constraints.description: At least the required number of distinct vegetable types must be selected

constraints.name: purchase_requires_selection
constraints.description: A vegetable item may be purchased only if it is selected

constraints.name: single_period_horizon
constraints.description: The planning horizon consists of a single period, so there is no intertemporal coupling

constraints.name: total_protein_definition
constraints.description: Defines total protein as the sum of protein contributions from purchased protein items and vegetables.

objectives.name: total_protein_maximization
objectives.description: maximize total protein intake achieved by the meal plan

final_objective.description: Maximize total protein intake of the meal plan. This is a single-objective MILP, so the original objective is used directly without combination.
